name: Prove mathematical theorems and verify statements
description: Users requested formal proofs, verifications of truth values, or error identification for a wide range of mathematical theorems, including topics such as number theory, set theory, measure theory, and logic. The requests often required specific proof techniques like induction and addressed both standard mathematical statements and flawed or paradoxical arguments.
